grade.primary_choice: Lean, tuned Java Spring Boot with JDBC on existing Postgres
red_flags_hit: Does not address high availability or data loss when a single VM restarts; it has no multi-instance or load-balancer plan
unsupported_claims: 'If Postgres runs on the same 512 MB VM, the design fails outright' is stated too strongly and has not been measured
grade.notes: This is a strong, team-aware recommendation. It covers memory tuning for 512 MB, idempotent scan ingestion, partitioning and retention, and a load test on the real VM, and it ranks Quarkus and other languages correctly as fallbacks. It leaves out running two or more instances behind a load balancer with health checks, and conventional tooling such as Flyway and actuator, and it only partly covers testing above the peak rate.
